label_policy.scope: exact historical frozen promotion OOF TopN, unchanged membership and rank
label_policy.date_rule: D/T/T+1 must be adjacent committed SSE open sessions
label_policy.entry: T daily open strictly below official up_limit with positive reported daily volume; this is a conservative daily-open proxy, not an auction fill or capacity claim
label_policy.known_no_entry: existing candidate row with explicitly zero volume, or valid open at official up_limit; cash zero, no transaction cost
label_policy.exit: first strict session from T+1 with positive volume and open strictly above official down_limit; opening at down limit remains blocked even if intraday trading later resumes
label_policy.missing_session: stop unresolved; never skip an unknown intervening session
label_policy.corporate_action: pre_close differing from prior observed close requires separate adjustment/cash-action evidence; keep unresolved without it
label_policy.cost_assumption: 45bp and 90bp are fixed round-trip fee/slippage scenarios, not measured execution costs; charged once on a filled slot only
label_policy.label_availability: known no-entry at T close; resolved exit at its observed session close, not scheduled T+1; training uses this date strictly before cutoff

training.features: existing 48 D-known columns only; exclude old 108 proxy-outcome priors whose availability did not account for delayed exits
training.heads: direct slot net return and max(-slot net return,0), both on the same mature complete-D training rows
training.selection: min(2,N) fixed daily, code ascending tie-break, absent slot cash zero, no score threshold and no padding
training.common_mask: all original candidates in a D must have terminal labels; report every incomplete D; at fit time all label_available_dates must be strictly before cutoff
training.baseline: same-D frozen promotion Top2, evaluated on the identical new-policy labels and candidate mask
training.existing_mixed_comparator: not available on identical historical fitting cutoffs; do not replay its full-history-trained artifact into earlier dates
training.insufficient_evidence: write readiness BLOCK and do not fit, serialize a model, or invent performance

requirements: positive net evidence after costs and stress
explicit entry-exit policy alignment with forward Shadow

legacy_reuse.execution: Exact byte copies of original scripts into an isolated external study; unchanged parameters, labels and gates; original source and outputs are read only.

source_admission.required: An externally SHA-pinned audit report must admit this exact run and manifest, have no issues or unresolved overlap conflict, and all required partitions must be verified. Missing candidate rows stay unknown, not zero.

overlay_policy.output: Only a new external empty temporary overlay and this new research package outputs; no overwrite of earlier outputs.
overlay_policy.source_identity: Collection now is retrospective evidence, never availability at historical D or new forward Shadow.

runner_mode.insufficient_data: Record BLOCK and zero model fits; no performance files
runner_mode.success: Still NO_RELEASE; no replacement of live model or P0 rankings.
